title: Video Editing Subscriptions Compared: Best Value for Small Businesses (2026)
meta_description: Video editing subscriptions cost about $99 to $1,700+ a month. Published plans compared per video, what's included, and the best value for small businesses.
keywords: best video editing service for small business

faq.q: How much does a video editing subscription cost?
faq.a: From about $99–$149 a month for a few short videos to $899–$1,700 or more for unlimited plans. UK-based plans like the Creator Fellow cost £119 a month.

faq.q: Is unlimited video editing worth it for a small business?
faq.a: Usually not. Unlimited plans suit teams publishing daily; most small businesses get better value from a fixed number of videos.

faq.q: What's the cheapest way to get Reels edited?
faq.a: A fixed-number subscription usually works out at £15–£30 per video, cheaper than most freelancers at £30–£150 per Reel.
Some do, most don't. Feedbird includes posting; ContentFellow posting is part of the Social Fellow.

faq.q: Can I try a video editing service for free?
faq.a: Some offer trials. The ContentFellow Creator Fellow edits 3 short videos free from your footage, and you keep them.
